question: Second-year IT student here, GPA 3.1 on a 4-point scale. Which grants am I eligible for?
answer:
Based on your CGPA of 7.75 (calculated as 3.1 ÷ 0.4) [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2], you are eligible for two currently open grants. Please note that applications are only accepted while the status is **open** [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].

### Open Grants
You may apply for the following grants:

| Grant Code | Title | Amount | Deadline |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| GR-DS-05 | Data Science for Governance Fellowship | ₹50,000 | 31 Dec 2026 |
| GR-OS-11 | Open Source Contribution Grant | ₹25,000 | 31 Dec 2026 |

*   **Data Science for Governance Fellowship (GR-DS-05):** You meet the requirements (CGPA 7.75 ≥ 7.5; Year 2; Department: IT) [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].
*   **Open Source Contribution Grant (GR-OS-11):** You meet the requirements (CGPA 7.75 ≥ 7.0; Year 2; Department: IT) [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].

### Closed Grants
The **Hardware Hackathon Seed Fund (GR-HW-06)** is currently **closed** [SQL], meaning it is no longer accepting applications [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].

Please ensure you submit your applications before the deadlines listed above, as late applications are not considered [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].
sql: SELECT grant_code, title, amount, application_open, application_deadline, status FROM grants WHERE grant_code = ANY(ARRAY['GR-OS-11', 'GR-DS-05', 'GR-HW-06']) ORDER BY application_deadline
